description: eta_sun: the default camera sensor's electrons per V-band photon for the Sun (5,772 K, log g 4.438), from the fitted colour table (crates/hyperion-sim/src/tables/star_colour.rs, CAMERA_ETA_SUN; rendering plan R06 Design notes 6 and 18, decision-camera-eta of 2026-10-02). Every star's camera band term is relative to it. The sim's test and the client's DEFAULT_VIEW_CAMERA.etaSun test both read this file; a refit of star_colour that moves the value updates it.
